text: Film Office Staff will provide updates on staffing, including Program Manager of the Film office and Film Permit Coordinators positions. Staff will also provide an update on Power Drops implementation, the implementation of film permit fees which come into effect in June 2022, and the Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board's recommendation on Item FB11.1, regarding easing filming at City-owned locations, adopted by the Economic and Community Development Committee on April 28, 2022 [ Item EC29.9 ]
The Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board received the item for information.
